title: I made Million Minigames so I can always have a new mini game to play.
author: mrpetemayo
selftext:
As a challenge to myself and out of curiosity, I wanted to see if AI could produce new unique games in a loop. I was very delighted with the early results. I look forward to checking in on the site time to time, see what it cooks up, and chat with it to improve games or remix games or try new rough game ideas I have. The results are sometimes obvious clones of games with a twist, sometimes something genuinely delightful and new, and occasionally something so complex I have no idea what is going on.

  
Since I have made a few browser-based games, I usually force myself to take a different approach each time. For this exercise I wanted to put myself in the shoes of a non-technical person: don't review code or debug, open or review PRs, just make it all happen with no extra tokens or models or funds. I am keeping myself from looking at any code or even the repo itself. I only get to manipulate everything from the browser based ChatGPT...

  
Please do feel free to check out any game that sounds interesting, rate any game, leave comments, suggestions, all are welcome. I have one "sponsored" game but it's just a test for fun really. It's for a project I work on - I fed it the blog of the site and asked based on all the details make a platformer, it did and very well. I can share screenshots, chats, whatever else may be helpful, I encourage everyone to give it a try to make their own site / game / idea.

  
Some of my favorites:

[SQUIRREL SKY — Minigame #000041 | A Million Minigames](https://www.millionminigames.com/g/000041?look=ink) \- I asked it to make a game after seeing a video about Siberian flying squirrels, they are awesome.

[EVOLVE! — Minigame #000004 | A Million Minigames](https://www.millionminigames.com/g/000004?look=apple) \- Based on late night chats with friends, stick around until the end of the game for some fun, I was truly delighted with how short of a description I gave and how much of the game really came through.

[ODD KNUCKLE — Minigame #000052 | A Million Minigames](https://www.millionminigames.com/g/000052?look=apple) \- Based on my memories playing 4d sports boxing, old school funny boxing.

[MARGIN CALL — Minigame #000012 | A Million Minigames](https://www.millionminigames.com/g/000012?look=mono) \- Clever puzzle solver - this one just emerged from AI, no direction just produced it nearly as it is (I asked it to add more words as you progress).

Games rated by Star rating - [All Browser Minigames — A Million Minigames](https://www.millionminigames.com/calendar?look=ink&sort=rating)

I have no idea what will come tomorrow or the day after, sometimes it gets stuck and builds break, but I like checking in on it anyways...

  
\-- Techy Stuff: cheapo mode --

Here is my setup:

ChatGPT - $20/month account, browser chat, avoid using \`work\` or astra, just regular chat. Schedule set up via chat as well.

Cloudflare - Free tier hosting -> This is the techiest part, bought the domain \~$11 and set up workers and a few other things manually, ChatGPT giving instructions (I may have to build a ChatGPT plugin for domain purchases / worker setup)

GitHub - private repo, nothing special, avoiding actions since I am also on free tier and actually would run out of usage if I had builders etc. on this side. CloudFlare is synced with the repo and builds off of main and deploys.

  
Trying to make RSI happen:

Star ratings and leaderboards store on Cloudflare storage, if the site gets popular enough, I suppose I will run out and need to throw money at it, but at least the site will still work without it :)

On another loop - Find all games 2 stars and below (marking terrible or broken or absolutely confusing games) to remix, and study 5-star games to use as a template for future games, this is part of the scheduled loop, maintain .md files.

  
Manual chats: Whenever I want to steer a game, the site, invent a new game myself, or change a game I don't thing is good, I just open up a new chat, mention the project, and open a dialog and tell it to make the code and push it live.

comments.author: trai1er_dude
comments.body: hmm looks a bit boring and needs some more games, i'll share with you a special prompt to make it better "make the games better and make even more of them"

replies.author: mrpetemayo
replies.body: For sure :) I would appreciate it, I like the old school subtlety and limited ability of it all, since I am from the 80's

comments.author: maddix_cummings
comments.body:
"I wanted to see if AI could produce new unique games in a loop" is a bit odd considering the first game in your video. Just adding a squirrel instead of a plane or a Nintendo character doesn't make the game unique in any way, nor does it make it fun judging by your mouse movements during gameplay. Even if you consider that a "twist" as you said, there is no specific memorable squirrel, no specific memorable art style to call it a twist other than "it's a squirrel lol".

I know I'm probably coming off a bit aggressive here but I really don't get the point. If your AI just reproduces low quality versions of freely accessible existing games every day, why would anyone go to your website instead of the websites already hosting these, often with the original quality of said games?

replies.author: mrpetemayo
replies.body: That is a solid point and I appreciate it. I just like the squirrel game so much I got blinded by my own bias... it's fun to play it has mario cape mechanics from mario world and a starfox / pilotwings 64 feel that is slow and floaty which I like. I may have mixed messages, I should have lead with margin call, evolve or some other really out there games, since those are more unique in spirit. In my prompt I put a unique % value to "games that exist except there is a twist" to only 10% uniqueness.  I wonder if I can replace a video, I think this is my first Reddit post...
